title: Web Producer / Web Platform Architect
description: Owned the WordPress web platform end to end as the sole web resource: content architecture, template system, TBO integration, QA tooling, editor enablement, and the Drupal-to-WordPress modernization.
longDescription: Owned the company's WordPress web platform end to end as the sole web resource: intake, build, QA, launch, updates, access, and documentation. Reported to the VP of Technology & Operations and drove adoption of platform, reporting, and workflow recommendations with leadership.

Designed the content architecture for the company's product content (custom post types, taxonomies, and relational content models for destinations, hotels, and itineraries) and the reusable template system that publishes thousands of structured pages from it.

Guided and supervised the work of 6+ distributed content contributors across Marketing and Solutions for four years: set priorities and publishing standards, assigned and reviewed page work, trained the editors, and wrote the process documentation, so day-to-day publishing no longer waited on a developer.

Designed the TBO integration layer: third-party property data imported through a custom UI, a live JSON store, and per-field source toggles, so editors could switch between internal and partner content without a developer and without manual re-entry.

Ran pre-launch QA across templates, copy, links, imagery, structured fields, responsive rendering, and accessibility; built audit views and a REST endpoint that surfaced completeness gaps and fallback behavior across large page collections before they reached customers.

Owned the platform modernization strategy: assessed a decade-old Drupal site with heavy technical debt, planned the phased cutover (landing pages first, then home page and navigation, then structured product content), delivered the public switch on a two-month timeline, and reduced Drupal to login-only pages with redirects in place.
Coordinated with the tech team, cloud infrastructure, and the acquirer's engineers (TBO) on hosting, integration, and data.
AI-assisted development (Claude, Cursor, Codex) as a production practice since 2023; recognized by management for bringing AI into the team's workflow.

title: Product Operations Admin (QA & Training)
description: High-volume QA and a consolidated PowerShell + SQL + Task Scheduler reporting platform; Excel/VBA tools; led the move to GitHub.
longDescription: Performed high-volume content, data, and booking QA where missed inconsistencies carried a direct financial cost; documented recurring failure modes and the fixes.

Designed and maintained a PowerShell + SQL + Task Scheduler reporting platform that consolidated hundreds of individual scheduled tasks into one maintainable system for two teams and cross-department stakeholders.
Built Excel/VBA tools that made high-volume reports such as the Inventory report faster to process and verify; took over and corrected production-critical SQL and maintained the query library.
Led the team's move to GitHub for version control, replacing email-based file sharing and manual backups; trained new hires and authored the workflow documentation.
